smart_read_file returned a folded whole-file skeleton headered 'Full body' when the symbol was not a declaration in that file (Go route closures), so read_file usage matched baseline (12,636 vs 13,102 chars/run) and the arm added 6,335 chars/run
2 of 9 runs hit max_steps repeating an identical build error
post_run_correction.fixed_in: tokensafe: smart_read_file symbol resolution (enclosing handler ±window, endpoint targets, honest miss), scoped_search per-file budget + grouped render, batch_editor occurrence lines on ambiguous hunks, arm loop scoped_search -> smart_read_file -> apply_edits+verify
